review.note: A7: the span was 28 February 1998 alone, the day the Kosovo War opened, which is the day this insurgency ended. At the cached revision 1370623741 the article's title reads "(1995-1998)", its first sentence "began in 1995" and its third "would lead to the more intense Kosovo War in February 1998". So 1995-1998, keeping 28 February 1998 as the end day; the start day goes.

title: Insurgency in Kosovo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Insurgency in Kosovo (1995–1998)", at revision 1370623741, opens: "The Insurgency in Kosovo began in 1995, following the Dayton Agreement that ended the Bosnian War. In 1996, the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) began attacking Serbian governmental buildings and police stations. This insurgency would lead to the more intense Kosovo War in February 1998." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18126038, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of the Yugoslav Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
